card.name: Scattered spots in dosing and iron text
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on a mix of words like iron, insulin, a space before a number, and digits in tables, in drug-label text.

modes.label: Drug or substance word
modes.description: A substance name such as iron or insulin right before a following term like chelation or -induced.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space just before a number giving a threshold or time span.

modes.label: Digits in a table
modes.description: Pieces of numbers inside a table of values.

card.plain: It fires on unrelated bits of label text, such as iron, insulin and numbers, with no single theme.
